items.title: Apple, Google and Samsung May Enable Always-On GPS in India
items.description: The Indian government is currently evaluating a controversial proposal from the telecom industry that would mandate smartphone manufacturers to enable “always-on” satellite location tracking. This move has sparked significant opposition from major technology companies, including Apple, Google, and Samsung, who argue it poses serious privacy and security risks.
